text: Kiara's picking up her new puppy on 14 May, a cockapoo called Pickle. She's already bought three beds for it lol
Chioma lives in Leeds now, works at the hospital in radiology. Her husband Femi is a teacher, two boys.
Remind me to text Zhang good luck before his flight to Chengdu on June 3rd, he hates flying and it's 13 hours
layla cat mochi at vets again kidney stuff she sounded really low. check in w her thurs
Olga and her partner Dmitri off to Japan 2nd-16th of April. First proper holiday in years. Ask for photos when they're back
Esther's dog Bramble turns 10 on the 22nd. She's doing a doggy cake. Honestly adorable.
Saanvi works for an architecture firm in Bristol, lives in Clifton with her sister Priya. Mentioned she grew up in Pune.

ok so voice note, just got off the phone with Ravi, um, he's flying out to Toronto on 5/14 for his cousin's wedding and he's back on May 28th, and he asked if I could water his plants while he's gone, so I need to get his spare key off him before he goes
Jin - vegetarian, allergic to cats, lives in Croydon. Works nights at the airport.
Aditi's trip to Peru got cancelled, airline went bust. Gutted for her. She's trying to rebook for September.
Must book the cattery for Biscuit before 3rd of August, I'm in Lisbon 4-11 Aug.
Samir's mum is having her cataract surgery on 12/11. He's driving down to Cardiff the night before. Call him the evening after to see how she is
Elif got back from Istanbul yesterday, said the flight was delayed 6hrs. She brought me Turkish delight! Her nan is 90 next month apparently.
Javier Gonzalez - new guy at work, from Seville, moved here in March. Has a greyhound named Paco. Into climbing.
Laura said her rabbit Clover died at the weekend. She'd had her nine years. Kids are devastated. I should drop round a card.

Lindiwe and Theo have booked their honeymoon, Cape Town then Zanzibar, flying out October 9th. They're both so excited. Lindiwe's never been on a flight longer than 3 hours so she's a bit anxious about the 11 hour leg but Theo's got it all planned, lounge passes, the lot. Her mum is coming to the wedding from Durban, landing on 28 Sept, first time meeting Theo's family.
Phoebe's starting her new job at the vet practice on 1 June. Bit nervous about the surgery side. Text her the night before
Aarav lives in Singapore, been there 6 yrs. Wife is Meera, she's a dentist. Their daughter is Anika, 4.
lachlan says his border collie Skye had 6 puppies on sunday!! he's keeping one. wants to know if i want one lol (no)
Need to get Theo something for his birthday 19 June. He keeps going on about a decent travel pillow since the Sydney flight

Juan rang this evening, um, he's flying back to Bogotá on the 30th to see his dad who's been in and out of hospital with his heart, and he's quite worried because his sister Valentina says it's worse than they're letting on. He doesn't know how long he'll stay, maybe two weeks, maybe longer, work have been good about it. Message him while he's there, and maybe offer to check on his flat.
Isla moved to Edinburgh last summer, works at the uni library. Her girlfriend is called Rosa.
Mehmet's cat Zeytin got out on Monday and hasn't come back. He's put posters up everywhere. Poor guy. Check in tomorrow if no news

Lunch with Salma. Her brother Karim just got engaged to his girlfriend Tamar, wedding probably next spring in Beirut. Salma's already planning outfits. She also mentioned her dad retired on 31 March and he's driving her mum mad.
Jess is off to Iceland Feb 12th to Feb 17th with her uni mates. Asked me for the name of that lagoon place. Send her the link
Graham and Moira - next door at no 14. Graham retired from the railways, Moira does the church flowers. They've got a parrot called Captain who swears.
Ana's new puppy Lola has parvo, she's at the emergency vet overnight. Ana is in bits. Text her first thing tomorrow
Anya works remotely for a Berlin startup, lives on a canal boat. Vegan. Hates small talk
Karim Novak (Kaz) - Salma's brother. Engineer at Rolls-Royce in Derby. Big F1 fan.
tamar mentioned shes flying to new york on 3/22 for a conference, nervous about the presentation on the 24th
Dentist 9am Thursday then pick up dog food. Book flights for Porto before prices go up.
Chioma's mum flying in from Lagos on 2nd of December, staying till New Year. Chioma's a bit stressed about hosting her for a month tbh
Ask Kiara how Pickle's first vet jab went
So Zhang got back fine from Chengdu, said his grandad's 80th was amazing. He's going back next year for Spring Festival. Should ask him to bring back some of that tea.
Layla update - Mochi is home and eating again!! Vet says chronic kidney disease, special diet from now on. Layla's relieved but exhausted.

Notes from catch-up with Olga: they loved Kyoto, hated the Tokyo heat. Dmitri lost his passport on the last day and they nearly missed the flight home. She's back at work on 22/04, dreading the inbox. Her sister Masha is due in July, first baby. Olga's going to be godmother. Want to get something small for the baby when it arrives, maybe a little Japanese blanket since they've just been.

Esther's dad lives with them now. He's 84, ex-navy, loves crosswords and still does the Times one in pen. Esther says it's nice having him there but the house feels tiny with him, her husband Paul, the two teenagers and Bramble. They're looking at a loft conversion. Her dad's from Glasgow originally, moved down in the 70s.
Saanvi's dog Bruno - had his leg op today. Vet said it went well but he's in a cone for 2 weeks. Saanvi's working from home to look after him.
Ravi texted from Toronto, wedding was huge, 400 people. He's staying an extra week, now back June 4th. Plants still need watering then.

Jin's sister Hana is moving to Melbourne in January for a PhD in marine biology. Jin's quite sad about it but trying to be supportive. Their parents are less supportive, his dad keeps saying it's too far. Hana flies Jan 9th, Jin is driving her to Heathrow. He's thinking about visiting her next Christmas, a whole month off if he can swing it.
Aditi rebooked Peru! September 8th to the 25th. Machu Picchu trek is 14 Sept. Need to lend her my walking poles before she goes
Samir's mum's op went fine, she's already moaning about the eye drops apparently lol

So had a long chat with Elif at Jess's party last night. She's thinking of moving back to Izmir to be nearer her parents, her dad's not been well and her brother Can is doing everything. Nothing decided. She'd be leaving her job at the council, which she loves. Didn't say much else, I think she's torn about it. Don't mention it to anyone.
Javier's greyhound Paco turns 7 next Tuesday, he's getting him a birthday puppuccino lol

Laura's kids are Ellie (9) and Sam (6). Her husband Matt works away a lot, oil rigs, three weeks on, three off. Ellie's mad about horses, Sam's into dinosaurs and anything with wheels. Laura works part time at the pharmacy on the high street and does Pilates Tuesdays. They live just behind the station on Albert Road.
Lindiwe asked me to feed their cat Nala while they're on honeymoon, Oct 9 to Oct 23. Pick up the keys on the 8th. Their wedding is the 4th of October!
Phoebe's first week went great, she's assisting on ops already. Her boss Dr Kim is lovely apparently.

Aarav messaged, he and Meera are visiting London 20 Dec for two weeks with Anika, staying with Meera's parents in Harrow. Their flight lands at 6am, poor Anika. They're also doing a few days in Edinburgh after Christmas, 27th to the 30th. Want to take them to the Natural History Museum, Anika is obsessed with dinosaurs. Need to book tickets this week, it sells out over the holidays.
lachlan's mum is flying over from Perth on 11/7 for 3 months. Long haul with a stopover in Dubai, she's 78. He's worried about her doing it alone. ask him if she got in ok on the 8th
Theo said Lindiwe's been sneaking looks at those Le Creuset pans. Could be a good wedding present.
Juan's dad is out of hospital. Juan's staying in Bogotá till the 15th. Sounded much better on the phone today.
Isla mentioned it's Rosa's birthday on 3 March, they're going to Paris for the weekend. Rosa loves macarons apparently.
Mehmet's cat came back!!! Zeytin turned up on Thursday night, skinny but fine.
Salma's flatmate is Jess's cousin Bea. Small world.
Grocery run, cancel the gym membership, renew passport (expires 8/14!!).

Over the fence with Moira this morning. Her grandson Callum is doing a gap year in Vietnam and Thailand, flies out on 1st Feb, back sometime in August. She's terrified of him going, keeps reading about scooter accidents. Graham says she'll be fine once he starts sending pictures. Callum's 18, just finished his A levels, wants to study geography at Leeds after.
Ana's puppy pulled through! Home on Saturday. Ana says the vet bill was £2k though. Maybe drop some treats round for Lola.
anya visiting her parents in Kraków 18th-26th of May. her mum's 60th is the 21st, big party. don't forget to message happy bday to her mum via anya
Tamar's presentation in New York went really well, her boss wants her to do the one in Chicago in June. Kaz flew out to join her for the weekend after, they went to see a Broadway show.

Kiara said Pickle chewed through her charger and her mum's slippers in one afternoon. She's signed up to puppy classes Saturdays starting 7 June. Also mentioned she and her boyfriend Lewis might move to a place with a garden next year.
